svg.title: HiveMQ CE under 150,000 msg/s offered
svg.desc: HiveMQ CE: delivered rate and broker memory over one rung, from start until the backlog drained. offered 150k/s · peak memory 11.7 GiB, 0 MiB at the end
svg.text: offered 150k/s · peak memory 11.7 GiB, 0 MiB at the end
not one client connected at 150,000 msg/s — nothing was delivered
data recovered from the chart rendered from the raw runs, which were not retained
